summary_en: 120,000 shares (2.54% of shares outstanding), ¥200M upper limit, market purchase via Tokyo Stock Exchange, Aug 14, 2026–Jan 29, 2027. Rationale: flexible capital allocation, capital-efficiency improvement, shareholder return, and potential future use for employee stock compensation.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Acquisition of Treasury Shares (Acquisition of Treasury Shares Based on Articles of Incorporation as Provided in Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On 13 August 2026, LTS Inc. (6560, TSE Prime) announced a treasury-share acquisition program authorized by its Board of Directors under Article 156 of the Companies Act as applied via Article 165(3). The company will acquire up to 120,000 ordinary shares (capped at ¥200M) via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period 14 August 2026 through 29 January 2027. Stated rationale: to enable flexible capital allocation in response to future business-environment changes, enhance capital efficiency, increase shareholder returns, and fund a portion of future share grants under the company's employee stock-compensation plan. The ex-treasury share count as of 31 July 2026 was 4,726,085 shares; the 120,000-share authorization represents 2.54% of that base.
